# Custom Input via YAML Manifest

## Summary

This fixture verifies that manifest.yaml supports the same configuration surface as manifest.json.

The YAML manifest should be able to select a custom input file, load plugins, and apply the configured theme just like a JSON manifest.

## Course Outline

### Module 1 - YAML Manifest Support
- Load a custom input file
- Apply plugin translations
- Apply the configured theme

### Module 2 - Validation
- Preserve output settings
